title: Rocket Nozzle Flow Simulation Tool — Overview and definition
t: Rocket Nozzle Flow Simulation Tool — Overview and definition
description: Analyzes compressible nozzle flow, thrust, and separation.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Analyzes compressible nozzle flow, thrust, and separation. A rocket nozzle tool solves quasi-1D and axisymmetric compressible flow with real-gas effects, predicting thrust coefficient, separation, and heat flux. Real implementations include TDK/BLM, NASA CEA-linked analyses, and CFD. It sizes contours (Rao optimum) and checks flow separation margins. Engineering analysis use only. Capability specification and design target: this database describes what the tool must do, not a claim of implementation or deployment.
